name: ecorione
description: Lapisan memori dan optimizer bersama untuk AI lokal maupun hosted

scripts.dev: concurrently -n rnd,context,connect,hub,ai -c yellow,cyan,magenta,green,blue "pnpm --filter @ecorione/rnd run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/hub run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run dev"
scripts.dev:phase2: concurrently -n rnd,context,connect,hub,mcp,sync,ai "pnpm --filter @ecorione/rnd run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/context run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/hub run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/connect run mcp:http" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/sync run dev" "pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run dev"
scripts.typecheck: tsc --build --verbose && pnpm --filter @ecorione/ai run typecheck && tsc --noEmit -p test/tsconfig.json
scripts.verify: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run secret-scan && pnpm run build
